topic: Ramachandran & Hubbard (2001, 2005) Synesthesia Visual Pop-Out Camouflage Matrix, Fusiform-to-V4 Cortical Cross-Activation, 90% Decade Consistency, and Bouba-Kiki Universal Sound-Shape Mapping (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Validation by fMRI and peripheral-crowding studies that neighboring ventral fusiform shape and V4 color regions cross-activate pre-attentively, alongside universal Bouba-Kiki cross-modal mapping.
